name: Smith Argus
summary: At Goldshire's forge, Smith Argus keeps travelers and local smiths supplied. He repairs gear, teaches new smiths, and sends horseshoes to Redridge while coordinating with Stormwind craftsmen.

sections.title: The Anvil of Goldshire
sections.body: Smith Argus works the forge near the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. Gnolls, kobolds, and Defias bandits threaten the area, but Argus keeps the local militia and passing adventurers equipped. He mends armor and makes sturdy tools. As a blacksmithing trainer, he teaches new smiths to work copper and bronze.

sections.title: Inter-Town Trade and Demands
sections.body: Goldshire's central position makes Smith Argus a link in Stormwind's regional supply. Craftsmen in nearby settlements turn to him for specialized gear and raw materials. Farrier Verner Osgood in Redridge depends on Argus for crafted horseshoes for pack animals and cavalry. Metalworkers in Stormwind's Dwarven District also arrange deliveries through him.

faq.q: Where can I find Smith Argus?
faq.answer: Smith Argus works at the outdoor anvil and forge behind the armor shop in Goldshire, near the Lion's Pride Inn in central Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What services does Smith Argus provide?
faq.answer: Argus teaches new blacksmiths the fundamentals. His Classic title is Journeyman Blacksmith.

faq.q: Why does a blacksmith in Redridge send me to Smith Argus?
faq.answer: Verner Osgood, a craftsman in Lakeshire, needs horseshoes to keep supply wagons and mounts moving against the Blackrock orc threat. He contracts Argus in Goldshire to forge and supply them.

faq.q: What is Argus's connection to Stormwind City?
faq.answer: Argus coordinates supply runs with dwarven smiths in Stormwind City, including Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District.

faq.q: Can Smith Argus train advanced or expert blacksmithing?
faq.answer: Argus teaches the early stages of blacksmithing. Advanced techniques require more experienced masters in larger settlements.

faq.q: Does Smith Argus belong to any particular guild?
faq.answer: Argus is a loyal subject of the Kingdom of Stormwind and belongs to the local craftsmen community serving the Alliance in Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: For Alliance characters starting in Elwynn, Argus may be their first forge teacher. He teaches initial recipes for rough copper gear and useful items.
Miners bring metal to Goldshire's forge, where Argus teaches new smiths to shape it into useful tools.
Argus reflects the hard work of Elwynn's tradesmen amid political neglect and bandit unrest.
